notes.title: Far Flight 1.0.0.4
notes.content:
New feature:
 Profiles can now be deleted from the profile selection menu
 Bug fixes:
 Gauss weapons would stop firing completely under certain circumstances
 Ability upgrades were applied more often than intended
 Ability upgrades were not correctly restored in a continued run
 Field effects created artefacts when pausing and then unpausing the game

notes.title: Far Flight 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
Added a short invulnerability time after selecting a level up or new gear
 Fixed Queen not dismissing her minions when she dies
 Fixed Eagle freezing in place
 Fixed the display of the explosion chance

notes.title: Far Flight is out now!
notes.content:
Far Flight 1.0 is now available. Here is what you can expect from the game:


Build your own build! There are a lot of weapons and ways to combine the different upgrades you get for your ship in a single run.
Fight different factions! Three different factions can be encountered in every run and every faction has a different approach in trying to get rid of you.
Enhance your next runs! Every run earns you credits which you can use to gain access to ship and loot improvements.
Use different ships and pilots! There are multiple ships and pilots you can combine to change the possible loot and upgrades in your run.
Combine items to get even better items! During a run you can combine your items in different ways to either up- or sidegrade your items.
Fight stronger enemies in increasing danger levels! Every successful run unlocks a new danger level for you to try your skills against better enemies.

notes.title: The Far Flight Demo is here!
notes.content:
The Far Flight Demo is out now. Go and try it out.

 You can fight against the first two factions on the first difficulty.
 All starting ships and pilots are available.
 All Items and upgrades can be found and used.
